location.basis: Wikidata coordinates for Sutkagen Dor (Q2369920: 25.49833 N, 61.95028 E) fall on a reddish, eroded rise west of a seasonal stream and east of a N-S road; the location is plausible but not confirmed by any identifiable wall.

sources.citation_or_service: Esri World Imagery tile service, https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}; Source: Esri, Vantor, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community
sources.north_label_text: Web Mercator grid north (true north at every point; north up)

main_system_reason: No Harappan line could be identified in the imagery.
notes: Optional town. The rise at the published position has a roughly rectangular reddish outline with some straight N-S edges, but at this resolution they cannot be told apart from erosion of the natural outcrop, and no wall face can be identified with confidence. We did not measure it.

diagnostics.method: see METHOD.md; deviation peaks from magnitude-weighted gradient-direction histograms folded modulo 90 degrees
